# RouteCase — In-Editor API Route & Endpoint Testing for VS Code

> RouteCase is a lightweight, declarative, 100% offline Visual Studio Code extension that allows developers to define API endpoints once in `.rcase` JSON files and execute multiple input scenarios (`success` and `errors`) directly within the editor using Jupyter-style CodeLens actions.

## Creator & Maintainer
- Author: Utkarsh Kumar (utkarshkumar712)
- GitHub Profile: https://github.com/UTKARSHKUMAR712

- Website Source: https://github.com/UTKARSHKUMAR712/routecase_website

## Core Capabilities & Architecture
- Declarative .rcase JSON Suites: Multi-case test documents clearly separating `success` and `errors` scenarios for a single route.
- Interactive Jupyter-Style CodeLens: Run full files, individual routes, or isolated test cases directly in the editor buffer with instant pass/fail badges.
- Scriptless Variable Chaining: `capture` maps extract JSON response tokens using dot notation (e.g. `data.auth.token`) and inject them into downstream tests as `{{token}}`.
- Built-in Dynamic Generators: `{{$uuid}}`, `{{$timestamp}}`, `{{$isoDate}}`, `{{$randomEmail}}`, `{{$randomInt}}`, `{{$randomName}}`.
- Environment Variable Resolution: Merges `.rcase.env` (dotenv format), `.rcase.env.json`, and VS Code workspace settings `routecase.env`.
- Multi-Level Assertions: Validates HTTP status code, deep JSON equality (`bodyEquals`), substring containment (`bodyContains`), response headers, and latency limits (`maxDurationMs`).
- Built-in Security: Automatic redaction of sensitive credentials (`Authorization`, `Cookie`, `x-api-key`) in test reports and UI.
- Native OpenAPI 3.0 & Swagger 2.0 Importer: Zero-dependency conversion of API specs into runnable `.rcase` suites.
- 100% Offline & Private: Zero telemetry, zero cloud dependencies, zero forced logins.
